svg.title: alibaba/nacos: 74% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 74% of 131 recent commits in alibaba/nacos carry a disclosed AI agent signature (131 commits, last 90 days). Claude Code 48%, OpenAI Codex 25%, Cursor 0.8%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
